correctness.rationale: The substitution sign s(3n)=s(3n+1)=s(n), s(3n+2)=-s(n) gives s(q3^k+r)=s(q)s(r), sum_{r<3^k}s(r)=1 and exact unaligned block sum (1-P_k(r))s(q)+P_k(r)s(q+1). The integer-affine sign-pair map is injective for integer P outside {0,1}, while no four consecutive s signs can agree; cubes occur exactly with P=0 or P=1 and the respective shifted three-sign run, and four consecutive equal blocks cannot occur. Constant three-sign runs have density 1/6 by t(3n)=0,t(3n+1)=1,t(3n+2)=1-t(n), yielding C_k/(6*3^k). A_k prefix/sign recurrence counts C_k exactly; independent direct word checks confirmed C_0..C_5=[1,2,5,13,35,96], 5460 cube/4-power positions, and the source gives a length-seven fourth-power witness. Existence of aligned threefold repetition comes from s(5)=s(6)=s(7)=-1.
